top._headline: Closing Duvernay decision window demands immediate Newpark incumbent defense
top._insight: With Chevron Canada's mud contract decision window closing around August 18 and M-I SWACO actively competing on this high-value 5,400m Duvernay pad, Newpark must mobilize immediately to leverage its preferred-vendor agreement before the incumbent position erodes.
